BBVI has zero federal court exposure, zero appearances in offshore leak databases, zero FARA or LDA registrations despite Kellerhals’s documented political activity, and its fees were not paid through any captured Deutsche Bank accounts. sections.title: Formation and Corporate Structure
sections.content:
Business Basics VI LLC was registered in the USVI on January 26, 2012, under entity number 582110, with Erika Kellerhals as resident agent. The entity was created to assume the registered agent function previously performed by Kellerhals Ferguson LLP. A formal corporate resolution for Nautilus Inc (EFTA01266733), signed by Jeffrey Epstein (President) and Darren Indyke (Secretary) on September 13, 2012, documents this deliberate transition: "the current agent for service of process of the Corporation, Kellerhals Ferguson LLP, hereby resigns as agent for service of process" and "the Corporation hereby appoints, Business Basics VI, LLC, as the new agent." The resolution was notarized by Harry I. Beller, Notary Public for the State of New York (Rockland County), confirming New York involvement in USVI corporate mechanics.

BBVI initially operated from 9100 Havensight, Port of Sale, Suite 15-16 — the same address as Kellerhals Ferguson LLP — before relocating to the Royal Palms Professional Building at 62-3A and 62-3B Estate Thomas, Suite 101 (mailing: 9053 Estate Thomas Suite 101). The Royal Palms location, described in one email as "the new office building behind the hospital" (EFTA02606182), is a multi-tenant professional complex housing medical and legal practices. BBVI shared Suite 101 with two formally affiliated entities, as disclosed on its own website (bizusvi.com/affiliates.html): Kellerhals Ferguson Kroblin PLLC, the law firm handling tax planning, EDC benefits, corporate transactions, and litigation; and West Indies Title LLC, the title insurance company (principal: Carrie de Leon) providing real estate closing services. The Kellerhals law firm also maintained a New York office at 40 Wall Street, 35th Floor, and was affiliated with Solomon Blum Heymann LLP, an AV-rated Wall Street firm. This tripartite structure meant that every aspect of a corporate entity’s lifecycle in the USVI — formation, ongoing compliance, legal representation, tax strategy, and property transactions — could be handled entirely within the Kellerhals ecosystem.

sections.title: Client Portfolio and Captive Nature
sections.content:
Registry database searches confirm that all entities with BBVI as registered agent are Epstein-connected. The sole exception is KFK Strategic Holdings LLC (USVI 585923, formed December 2015), the holding company for the Kellerhals Ferguson Kroblin law firm itself — creating a circular dependency where BBVI manages KFK, and KFK PLLC is the affiliated law firm of BBVI. The confirmed Epstein entities serviced by BBVI include: LSJE LLC (581737), Southern Trust Company Inc (581871), Poplar Inc (581872), Cypress Inc (581974), Nautilus Inc (581975), Maple Inc (581976), Laurel Inc (581980), Freedom Air Petroleum (581842), Southern Financial LLC (583164), Southern Country International Ltd (584624), Hyperion Air LLC (582952), JEGE LLC (582953), Plan D LLC (582954), Prytanee LLC (586644), Gratitude America Ltd, Zorro Management LLC, IGO Company LLC, Cypress Hill LLC, Bayview Holdings LLC, and Mermaid Cove LLC, among others.

Despite its website presenting BBVI as a general-purpose corporate services company offering "business formations, obtaining necessary licenses, preparing all annual statutory filing requirements as well as providing resident agent services," zero non-Epstein clients have been identified across the DOJ Volume 11 database, DugganUSA, LMSBAND, the Unified DB, Epstein 20K corpus, USVI corporate registry, or the broader investigation database. The website’s SSL certificate has expired (HTTP-only as of February 2026), and the entity maintains a Twitter/X account (@BizUSVI) with minimal activity. This presents the appearance of a legitimate multi-client firm while functioning as a captive single-client operation. The "business consultant" classification on Southern Trust Company’s USVI business license (EFTA01297594), where Brett Geary was listed as primary contact, may have been selected to support EDC tax benefit claims rather than to reflect actual multi-client consulting activity.

sections.title: Key Personnel and Compartmentalization
sections.content:
Two individuals formed BBVI’s operational core. Erika Kellerhals, a USVI attorney and the entity’s resident agent, controlled the registered agent function for all Epstein USVI entities and held officer titles (Secretary and Treasurer) at multiple Epstein entities. She was the local USVI touchpoint for Deutsche Bank relationship managers, appearing in KYC filings alongside inner-circle members Harry Beller, Darren Indyke, and Richard Kahn (EFTA01386745). However, a critical distinction separated her from the New York principals: Kellerhals was listed for "Contact Information" only, while Indyke and Kahn were listed for "Current ID" — meaning they held actual account access. Richard Kahn explicitly denied Kellerhals financial signing authority (EFTA01373347). This was deliberate compartmentalization: Kellerhals provided the local legal infrastructure, government relations, and corporate compliance layer, while Kahn and Indyke retained exclusive financial control from New York. BBVI and KFK PLLC functioned as the USVI service layer of a New York-controlled financial operation.

Brett A. Geary (confirmed female per notarized formation documents) served as the operational backbone of BBVI. An IRS Enrolled Agent described as a "business consultant" by the Virgin Islands Daily News (May 7, 2019), Geary personally organized at least seven Epstein USVI entities as incorporator — including Zorro Management LLC, Prytanee LLC, and others — alongside Kellerhals and Gregory Ferguson. She was the named business contact on Southern Trust Company’s business license and handled entity formations, annual compliance filings, and tax preparation. Geary’s reach extended beyond domestic entities: the Articles of Organization for Prytanee LLC (EFTA01296059) list her as sole organizer, with the initial manager address at "6-04 Avenue Evenement" — a French address consistent with Prytanee’s function as an art acquisition vehicle for Etienne Binant in Paris. A third incorporator, Nicole Miller of St. Thomas, appears on at least one set of formation documents (EFTA01387097), apparently to satisfy USVI minimum incorporator requirements. USVI Division of Corporations personnel lists also reference Thomas Hanratty, Cara Traynor/Robinson, Kelly Robinson/Traynor, and William Avery Thomas as authorized contacts associated with BBVI-serviced entities.

sections.title: Financial Opacity
sections.content:
Zero financial transactions involving Business Basics VI LLC, Brett Geary, or Erika Kellerhals appear in the DS10 Deutsche Bank dataset, which covers 579 transactions totaling $304 million across Epstein’s captured bank accounts. This is investigatively significant: the registered agent company managing the entire USVI corporate infrastructure was not paid through the banking channels subpoenaed by the SDNY grand jury. BBVI fees and Kellerhals legal fees likely flowed through separate banking channels. FirstBank of the Virgin Islands (later FirstBank Puerto Rico) is documented for at least one Epstein entity — Laurel Inc’s banking records appear at EFTA01269393 — and Fedwire records show Gratitude America Ltd receiving $150,000 (December 11, 2017) and $233,087.94 (annotated "TO CLOSE DB ACCOUNT") at the BBVI/Kellerhals address via Deutsche Bank Trust Company Americas to FirstBank Puerto Rico.

The BBVI address at 9100 Havensight (and later Royal Palms) served as the official IRS and banking address for Gratitude America Ltd, Epstein’s primary charitable vehicle. The foundation’s IRS 501(c)(3) tax-exempt determination letter (EFTA01365895), dated September 27, 2012, was addressed to the Havensight suite. This means BBVI’s physical address anchored both the corporate formation infrastructure and the charitable entity’s regulatory identity, concentrating multiple distinct functions at a single controlled address. Combined with zero results for bizusvi.com email addresses in the DOJ Volume 11 corpus, this suggests BBVI’s operational communications and financial dealings were deliberately segregated from Epstein’s personal email accounts and the Deutsche Bank relationships that ultimately attracted regulatory scrutiny.

sections.title: Continued Operations (2019-2026)
sections.content:
BBVI has remained continuously active since Epstein’s death in August 2019, with its most recent annual report filed April 7, 2025. The post-death period reveals three distinct operational threads. First, ongoing maintenance: BBVI itself and Kellerhals Ferguson Kroblin PLLC both maintain "In Good Standing" status with current annual reports. Second, active estate operations: Southern Financial LLC (583164) was administratively dissolved four times in 2024-2025 but restored each time — most recently February 21, 2025, with Brett Geary’s email (brett@bizusvi.com) listed as agent contact — indicating deliberate effort to keep this particular entity alive. Meanwhile, the J. Epstein Virgin Islands Foundation (551494) was voluntarily dissolved on November 6, 2024, suggesting selective wind-down of legacy Epstein entities. Third, new entity formation: Cypress Hill LLC (DC0128296) was registered through BBVI on March 26, 2024, and Kellerhals Law P.C. (DP0137481) was registered on January 28, 2026 — just weeks before the date of this analysis — as Erika Kellerhals’s solo professional corporation at the same 9053 Estate Thomas address.

The formation of Kellerhals Law P.C. as a separate solo entity, distinct from Kellerhals Ferguson Kroblin PLLC, suggests either partner departure or a strategic restructuring of the legal practice. Brett Geary was confirmed at the same St. Thomas address via a 2024 FEC donation record. Meanwhile, BBVI has achieved a remarkable degree of legal and media insulation: zero federal litigation as a party (per comprehensive CourtListener search), zero appearances in ICIJ/OCCRP offshore leak databases, zero OpenSanctions matches, zero GDELT news results for "Kellerhals Epstein" or "Business Basics Epstein," and zero FARA or Lobbying Disclosure Act registrations despite Kellerhals’s documented political activity including arranging meetings between Epstein and both USVI Governors Mapp and Bryan.
